reports.title: Arkansas wetland habitat update

scope.name: Selected AGFC-managed wetlands and statewide habitat context
scope.description: Agency habitat update, not an aerial duck survey. State reference only; no surveyed footprint or current flock positions supplied.

reports.method: Published agency account of managed-wetland water availability; no standardized bird abundance estimates.
reports.headline: Water was limiting the habitat.
reports.summaryNote: AGFC described prolonged drought and constrained flooding of managed wetlands ahead of the season.

regions.name: Managed moist-soil units
regions.note: At the beginning of October, water was available to flood only 42% of AGFC-managed units.

regions.name: Surface-water sources
regions.note: Many lakes, streams, and ditches were too low for existing pumps.

regions.name: Raft Creek WMA
regions.note: Pumping was underway, with limited floodable acreage described in the report.

managedMoistSoilFloodingCapability.definition: AGFC-managed moist-soil units with adequate water available for flooding, not the percentage already flooded.

reports.provenance: October 22, 2026 publication; Low-Water Woes and The Problem With Pumping sections. Some conditions were presented at an October 7 committee meeting.
notes: Publication and observation periods differ. This is dated seasonal habitat context, not today's conditions or a bird-arrival prediction.
Flooding capability does not establish actual inundation or duck abundance.

reports.title: Cheyenne Bottoms field observations
reports.observationPeriodLabel: Sightings reported over the couple of weeks preceding October 13, 2026; exact dates not supplied.

scope.name: Cheyenne Bottoms and nearby wetlands, Kansas
scope.description: Public-university field observations around Cheyenne Bottoms. The Kansas outline is only a report reference, not statewide observation coverage.

reports.method: Education-center narrative compiled from local bird sightings; species presence is not a standardized count or trend.
reports.headline: More habitat, with ducks in the mix.
reports.summaryNote: The center reported improving duck diversity after rain and canal water replenished Cheyenne Bottoms pools.

regions.name: Cheyenne Bottoms habitat
regions.note: Rain and incoming canal water improved wetland habitat; stored water had been redistributed among pools.

regions.name: Reported duck species
regions.note: Mallards, gadwall, northern pintails, and green-winged teal appeared in the preceding-weeks sightings list; counts were not supplied.

reports.provenance: October 13, 2026 page date; opening habitat paragraphs and the species list explicitly covering the last couple of weeks.
notes: The observation window is approximate; October 13 is the publication date, not a single-day survey.
Only the center's published summary is used. Underlying birder submissions and eBird records were not imported.
